reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis aligns with known effects of magnetic-impurity additions on superconductivity in such alloys and the microstructural evidence presented supports a scientifically coherent mechanism.
reasons.testability: They propose clear, standard measurements (AC susceptibility, heat capacity, WHH analysis) with a direct comparison to a well-defined reference, offering a feasible and decisive way to test and falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis directly addresses whether and how Tb addition affects superconductivity in a high-entropy alloy, providing tangible methods and expected outcomes that can guide further research on superconducting properties in such systems.
